Swiss Army Bench 0.0.5: the Windows installer stops a running copy before it installs.

- In 0.0.4 the installer failed with "failed to remove directory ...\uv\tools\swissarmybench\Scripts: Access is denied"
  when the app (or an editor's Swiss Army Bench agent tools) was still running from the installed copy: Windows
  will not replace files a running program has open. The installer now asks the server to stop, stops anything
  still running from the installed copy, and tries the install up to three times.
- Everything in 0.0.4 (the tray, start at sign-in, updates from the tray, the token out of sight) is here.

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
